Best restaurant
Oct 2026 • Family
We came in on a very busy weekend and the restaurant was absolutely packed, but Hanni, the manager, welcomed us warmly and quickly sorted a table for us. She was calm, friendly and very polished, and her recommendations were spot on.

Khan was brilliant as well. He was attentive without being overbearing, kept everything moving smoothly and was always on hand when we needed anything. You could tell he genuinely cared about giving us a good experience.

What really stood out was the way Hanni and Khan worked together. They complemented each other so well and were constantly supporting one another, even with the restaurant being so busy. The service felt effortless, which is no mean feat on a packed weekend.

The meat was absolutely superb beautifully prepared, tender and full of flavour. The side dishes were lovely too, and were topped up regularly without us ever needing to ask. Little touches like that make a real difference.

All in all, a cracking evening. Great food, brilliant service and two genuinely lovely people looking after us. Hanni and Khan are a credit to the place.

Honestly, at this level of food, service and attention to detail, I’d say the restaurant deserves proper Michelin recognition.

Five stars from us.

Worth dining than ever
Sep 2026 • Couples
I visited Veteran Restaurant on a busy weekend evening, and despite the crowd, the spacious layout and strong ventilation kept the ambience fresh and smoke-free. The culinary highlight was undeniably the Japanese Wagyu; expertly seared on the signature stone grill, its rich marbling melted into an amazingly juicy, tender bite. Next up, the marinated beef ribs were exceptional, thickly cut and soaked in a well-balanced, savory-sweet Korean marinade that caramelized beautifully on the edges while remaining tender inside. The table was generously stocked with fresh panchan and fluffy steamed egg, rounded off perfectly with a bowl of refreshing cold Naengmyeon noodles to cleanse the palate. What truly elevated the meal was the top-tier service: the staff grilled every cut right at our table to medium perfection, allowing us to just relax and enjoy. At around 1mil VND per person, it is a high-end BBQ experience, but the flawless meat quality and seamless hospitality make it worth every penny. Just be sure to book a table in advance if you visit on a weekend!

Thank you Huy, it was lovely to have you as our waiter.
Jul 2026 • Family
It was our first visit to a Corean BBQ place. Not knowing that a dozen side dishes would be served with the dinner, we ordered hungry... A little later the table was FULL of little bowls that were also refilled again and again. Our waiter Huy took very good care of us. We realized that this type of BBQ is not for everyone: The style of meet is different from European cooking and cut in very think slices. What appears on your plate has nothing to do with a steak or something you would expect in a European steakhouse. But it is most certainly an interesting and tasty experience!
